items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, monetization expansion, revenue forecast, ROI claim, or budget commitment. The only revenue evidence is Amazon for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. All $4.92 is under aggregate tracking_id=other, so site revenue, contribution margin, CAC, ROI, and revenue forecasts are unsupported. Named site rows show $0 attributed income; allthingsmasonic.com shows 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Current AI usage is 16 calls costing $2.2785467 on 2026-10-01 across only 4 instrumented sites; fleet AI cost-to-learn is not calculable because incremental outcomes and 34 sites' AI costs are missing. Infrastructure, fixed, and marketing budgets are blank, so total budget exposure and contribution margin cannot be calculated. Minimum measurement needed: dated site/content-level revenue and commission, direct AI/infrastructure cost allocation, and verified incremental outcome linked to each change. Keep the existing capacity gate: 10/10 delivery slots occupied, 57 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 108 approved proposals without execution. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z before admitting the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA work; measure clicks only and do not claim financial lift.
